as_told.title: Townsend Brown, time travel and Bahnson's high-voltage anomalies

plain: The American inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, who experimented with high voltage in the hope of affecting gravity, is said to have believed his work had "clear implications for time travel." Michels says this himself on two episodes without naming a source, once adding that Brown was "obsessed with time travel." The second time, Michels adds that Agnew Bahnson, the man who funded Brown, was known for remarks along the same lines about strange effects at high voltage.
